title: ExtlRecShrPicklistMap - Data API
description: Represents the external record share picklist field mapping between the partner and vendor system for Partner Connect. This object is available in API version 62.0 and later.

ImportedPcklstOptionId.description: ID of the external record share picklist option of the external system. This field is a relationship field.

InternalPcklstOptionId.description: ID of the external record share picklist option of the internal system. This field is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: To see this object, enable Partner Connect or Partner Connect for Vendors. See Set Up Partner Connect as a Partner and Set Up Partner Connect as a Vendor in Salesforce Help.
